The UAE has intercepted 541 drones, 165 ballistic missiles and 2 cruise missiles as of Sunday, March 1, after attacks started across Gulf countries on Saturday.

The UAE's Terminal High Altitude Area Defence (Thaad) system is one of the most advanced in the world, with its ‘hit-to-kill’ ability in which an interceptor flying at Mach 8 (9,900kph) can hit an attacking weapon head on.

CENTCOM Update 

TAMPA, Fla. – As of 7:30 am ET, March 2, four U.S. service members have been killed in action. The fourth service member, who was seriously wounded during Iran’s initial attacks, eventually succumbed to their injuries. 

Major combat operations continue and our response effort is ongoing.

The identities of the fallen are being withheld until 24 hours after next of kin notification.
